# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are provided for the latest release of the 0.1.x series.
Releases 0.0.x are no longer supported.

| Version | Supported |
| --- | --- |
| 0.1.x | Yes |
| 0.0.x | No |

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report vulnerabilities privately. Do not open a public issue or pull
request for a suspected security problem.

- Use GitHub private vulnerability reporting: open the repository's
  **Security** tab and choose **Report a vulnerability**.
- Or email `dtxwiki.ai@gmail.com`.

Include the affected version, how you deployed dtxWiki (solo, systemd or
Docker), the steps to reproduce, and the impact you observed. Do not include
real credentials or personal data in the report.

You can expect an acknowledgement within a few days. We will keep you informed
while we investigate, release a fix for supported versions, and credit you in
the release notes if you wish.
